source.authorityBoundary: Sealed typed-link replay and RNCS replay admission only; native authority-plan compilation, canonical write and promotion remain separate.

archaeology.reuseDecision: Reused the existing package lock verifier, typed-link receipt, RBC decoder, native VM and canonical root owner; added only sealed bytecode replay and RNCS admission binding.
archaeology.recompileAvoided: Replay consumes the sealed receipt and RBC bytes without reparsing source or creating a second typed compiler.

positiveEvidence: RCL replay verifies the sealed receipt before consuming bytecode.
Replay binds bytecode SHA-256, byte length, instruction count and typed instruction count to the receipt.
The existing native VM re-executes the RBC bytes and reproduces native semantic-state root, native state root, state-root verification/parity and reference/native parity.
RNCS replay admission binds the result to the candidate root and preserves replay_only=true plus canonical_write_authorized=false.
The fixed typed package replay and RNCS replay admission roots are independently verifiable.
negativeEvidence: Receipt, candidate-root and authority tamper cases remain covered by the typed-link and RNCS control-plane tests.
The same package source is still rejected by compileRclSource() native authority compilation with RCLC_COMPILER_FAILURE; replay does not promote that path.
No canonical world mutation, RFE merge, RSR mutation, physical device, production deployment, external transport or K400 PASS is established.
